subject: Authorization artifact intake: HealthNova SOC 2 / SIG packet
messages:
From: Leah Patel <leah.patel@healthnova.com>
To: sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai
Cc: security@healthnova.com
Date: Thu, 20 Nov 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: SOC2 intake: access control artifacts we need

Hi Sergio,

We are kicking off our SOC 2 readiness review and AuditFirm (cc: Tom) asked us to collect a focused set of access-control / provisioning artifacts from Redwood. Specifically they requested samples for SSO/SAML assertions, SCIM provisioning deltas, role-to-permission mappings (RBAC), and a short attestation about least-privilege controls.

Can you send a packet or point us to a delivery with the following items?
- SAML metadata + 3 sample assertion payloads (with PII redacted)
- SCIM delta export covering the last 30 days (CSV acceptable)
- Role-to-permission mapping + owner for each role (spreadsheet)
- Description of how we enforce least-privilege, service account handling, and JIT admin flows
- Any session/login traces that show enforcement (sample logs)

We aim to have the intake package by EOD 11/24 if possible. If you need approvals or an NDA for anything, call that out.

Thanks — Leah
Leah Patel
Security Lead, HealthNova
leah.patel@healthnova.com

On Thu, Nov 20, 2025 at 9:12 AM Leah Patel <leah.patel@healthnova.com> wrote:
> We are kicking off our SOC 2 readiness review and AuditFirm (cc: Tom) asked us to collect a focused set of access-control / provisioning artifacts from Redwood...

Thanks, Leah — we can provide the artifacts you listed. Below is what we'll deliver and a short workback. If you need any of these items in a different format, let us know.

Deliverables (proposed):
1) redwood-sso-scim-rbac-summary.pdf — summary narrative describing controls for SSO (SAML), SCIM provisioning, RBAC, and least-privilege enforcement. Includes references to our runtime, caching, and role-binding patterns.
2) saml-assertion-examples.txt — three redacted assertion examples (SubjectNameID replaced with SAMPLE_USER), and canonical metadata (entityID, cert thumbprint).
3) scim-delta-sample.csv — sample SCIM delta export (last 30 days) showing add/update/delete operations and actor id. We'll mark service accounts and system actors.
4) access-ownership-matrix.xlsx — mapping of role -> permissions -> owner, with notes on delegated admins.
5) session-trace-samples.log — sample auth/session trace lines showing enforcement (timestamps, outcome codes).

Workback and asks:
- Target delivery: Mon 2025-11-24 17:00 PST.
- HealthNova action: please confirm the tenant id (HN-4231) and provide 2 exemplar user IDs (one standard user, one admin) to include in the redaction checklist.
- Legal/NDAs: items above are non-sensitive; we'll redact email addresses/UIDs. If you require a separate DPA or NDA for log samples, flag that now.

I'll attach the summary checklist now (internal draft) and finalize artifacts next week.

Mina Haddad
Sr. Product Security Manager | Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai

Attachments: [Attachment: artifact-intake-checklist.pdf (PDF, 210KB)]
From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: mina_haddad@redwood.ai, sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai, Leah Patel <leah.patel@healthnova.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Nov 2025 14:15:00 -08:00

On Thu, Nov 20, 2025 at 11:50 AM Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Thanks, Leah — we can provide the artifacts you listed. Below is what we'll deliver and a short workback.

Quick technical notes for the package and extraction plan:
- SCIM deltas: we'll export from our provisioning pipeline (Delta stream v3) to a CSV. The export will include: op (create/update/delete), resourceType, id, actor_id, timestamp, and attribute diffs. Example attached (scim-delta-sample.csv).
- SAML assertions: we'll pull three assertion files from the assertion-archive (retention 90d). We will redact NameID/email and replace with SAMPLE_USER markers.
- RBAC mapping: role definitions live in the role-service; we'll run a role-owner snapshot that emits CSV columns: role_id, role_name, permissions, owner_email.
- Service accounts: we'll include a runbook excerpt for onboarding and rotation of service keys.
- Security controls: encryption at rest (AES-256), TLS1.2+, and HSM/KMS for signing keys (we'll include key policy reference).

Location for internal artifacts (for reviewers): s3://redwood-compliance/healthnova/2025-11-20 (will be zipped before external handoff).

Attachment: scim-delta-sample.csv (small scrubbed sample).

- Jonas (Platform Security/Infra)
